title: Vote Fly
needs_owner_check: Claim-only vote fly (fly bank 2.1.0, mc-server origin/main) is assumed live on the SMP.
summary: **Vote Fly** is flight time you earn by voting. Each vote banks 2 minutes of `/fly`, and the bank only counts down while you are in the air.
infobox: Your claims, or claims you are trusted to build in

blocks.p: Vote for the server with `/vote`. Every vote adds 2 minutes to your fly bank.
Day 3 of your [daily streak](/wiki/smp/daily-streak/) adds 10 minutes.

ul: Type `/fly` to take off and `/fly off` to stop. `/flytime` shows how much time you have banked.
The bank only counts down while you are in the air. Time on the ground is free.
A boss bar shows the time left while you fly. It turns yellow at 60 seconds and red at 10.
Vote fly works inside a claim you own or have build trust in (`/trust`). Access or container trust is not enough, and neither is the wilderness.
Flying out of the claim drops you with slow falling. Your bank is kept.
There is no vote fly in the KOTH arena or the dungeon.
A PvP hit grounds you and blocks `/fly` for 15 seconds.
Vote on every site: each vote banks its own 2 minutes.

history.text: Each vote now gives 2 minutes of fly.
Vote fly now lets you glide with an elytra, and `/fly` lifts you off the ground.
Vote fly now works only inside your own claims or claims you are trusted in.
Added vote fly: every vote adds 5 minutes of `/fly` to your bank, and it only drains while you fly.
